answer_1.quote: In this paper, we explore whether we can leverage the generation ability of the state-of-the-art LMs, to generate augmented samples for a given target class.
answer_1.outputs: augmented sentences conditioned on target class labels

answer_2.quote: We also use perplexity (PPL) as an auxiliary metric to evaluate the augmentation quality.

answer_4.quote: We conducted human evaluation on Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk)... Participants were asked to answer a series of questions about label agreement (e.g., "How much do you agree with the assigned class label?" on a 7-point scale) and rate the readability of samples on a 7-point scale (lower scores correspond to lower readability and vice versa).
answer_4.guideline: Participants rated label agreement and readability using 7-point Likert scales.
